verdict_text: YES. The script verifies identical name sets and bit-equality of every non-MLP tensor in all three checkpoints before any edit, computes each of the 48 MLP tensors in float32 as `base + 0.4*(ft1-base) + 0.4*(ft2-base)` against the unmodified base, takes all other tensors from the base unchanged, asserts exactly 48 merged and 114 output tensors, and writes a single `out/T4/model.safetensors`. The only assumption is that the imported `_ckpt.load_checkpoint` helper correctly loads both the sharded base directory and single-file fine-tunes; the script itself is correct.
